thread:
people-ops: Org update  Amir Basu joining Redwood Inference as Sr. Director, Product Operations, start date 2026-08-03. He'll own cross-functional ops for Dedicated & Private launches, internal SLAs for product delivery, and the product-ops playbook. We'll be opening a few backfills and a new TPM role to support launch cadence. :tada:

Aisha Patel: Huge welcome to Amir! Hiring note: we'll convert one contractor TPM into a perm TPM (new HC) and backfill two IC product ops roles. I'll post HC codes and req owners this afternoon.

Diego Morales: Excited to have Amir on board. I'll be handing over day-to-day product ops responsibilities and retaining strategic account leadership. Target handoff window: 2026-08-03 to 2026-09-01.

Amir Basu: Hi all  thrilled to join. First 30 days: meet PMs and GTM leads, audit our launch runbooks, and prioritize top-3 process pain points. Happy to do team-level AMAs next week.

Evan Carter: Budget question  are the two product ops backfills net-new or reallocated? Need to lock this for FYQ3 forecasting.

people-ops: Evan  one backfill is reallocated (PROD-OPS-210), the contractor-to-perm TPM is a newly approved slot (PROD-OPS-211). We'll add details to the HR change form.

Karen Li: For the TPM conversion  what's the proposed interview loop? I suggest PM + Eng Manager + People Ops + a brief case exercise on launch sequencing.

Aisha Patel: Agreed. Interview flow: 1) internal screen (2 days internal window), 2) case + 45m panel, 3) final comp review. HiringBot  please create the Greenhouse opening and set internal-first referral window to 3 business days.

HiringBot: Reminder: create job posting with tag "product-ops" and set referral window to 3 business days. Rubric due 2026-06-15.

Diego Morales: Amir  I'll prepare a consolidated handoff doc (projects, SLAs, current blockers) and a short list of account escalations that need visibility. Expect that by 2026-07-25.

Amir Basu: Thanks Diego  would appreciate a 30min walk-through on the Dedicated onboarding checklist and the current rollout calendar.

people-ops: Onboarding link: https://redwood.company/onboarding/product-ops. Please add any bespoke launch playbooks under "Amir Basu onboarding" folder.

Aisha Patel: Reminder on compensation banding  Sr Director = Level 7. Relocation and signing bonus handled case-by-case; people-ops to draft offer.

Evan Carter: For the two product ops backfills  can we prioritize internal candidates? We have a couple of strong applicants in customer-success and eng-platform.

people-ops: Internal-first confirmed. Aisha  please run 3 business days internal referral window before external posting.

Karen Li: One more ask  let's freeze any major product launch calendar changes during the handoff window (2026-08-03 to 2026-09-01) unless critical. We need stability for accounts.

Diego Morales: Agree. I'll flag the freeze to the go-to-market leads and post exceptions.

Amir Basu: Looking forward to meeting the team  I'll share a 30/60/90 plan on my first day and schedule open office hours for the first two weeks. DMs open for syncs.

people-ops: Action items recap: Aisha to post HC codes + req owners; HiringBot to create GH openings + remind for rubrics; Diego to publish handoff doc by 2026-07-25; Amir to share 30/60/90 on 2026-08-03. Welcome Amir! :confetti_ball:
